title.narrative: UNDP Fas II - Förstärkning av offentlig förvaltning

description.narrative: Att bidra till att stärka offentliga institutioner i delstaten Guatemala för gott styre för en hållbar och rättvis utveckling
To contribute to strengthening public institutions of the State of Guatemala for good governance for an sustainable and equitable development
To contribute to the implementation of the Government Plan to provide the Guatemalan population good public services and to attend their needs and priorities.

During the period, UNDP has been providing financial support and technical assistance to selected key government institutions which include:
1. National Anti-Corruption Commission CNC
2. Secretary of Planning and Programming of the Presidency SEGEPLAN
3. Secretary of Communications of the Presidency
4. Vice presidency of the Republic and attached secretaries
5. Private Secretary to the Presidency SPP
6. Secretary General of the Presidency SGP
7. Ministry of Social Development MIDES
Donors to the basket fund have included Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, Norway and USAID. Sweden has participated with a contribution of 11 186 000 kr.
Relevant results reported by UNDP include the following:
- the National Anti-Corruption Commission strengthened its institutional capacities by updating the indicators for public integrity according to OCDE standards, allowing for its participation in international forums
- the Executive Branch implemented an Integrity Network, linking 67 government institutions under common transparency and public probity strategy
- institutional procedures to receive and process corruption claims were standardized through creation of Manual for Criminal Complaints for Probity Officers, which strengthens the Executive Branch internal controls
- 289 public officials were trained in corruption prevention, public integrity and ethical management through workshops and technical training modules
- in the Secretary of Planning and Programming of the Presidency (SEGEPLAN), 1 109 public officials from 13 geographical departments were trained in the use of planning tools, such as Multiannual Operative Planning, Annual Operative Plan and financial programming, which strengthened technical capacity of local governments to implement projects aligned with national government priorities
- a new scholarship program "For Our Future" was designed and implemented, including a new web site and a national 3D scholarship fair which allowed participation from rural areas of Guatemala. 9 270 postulations were registered (63% women, 37% men)
- construction of Presidential Goals was supported through participatory process, prioritizing 12 goals and 22 priority interventions aligned with General Government Policy
- the institutional capacities of the Ministry of Social Development were strengthened to lead strategic planning processes and coordination of the national social protection policy
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
